name: Toughen
body:
Discipline: psychometabolism; Level guardian 0

MANIFESTING

Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Display: auditory, material

EFFECT

Range: 30 ft.
Target: 1 living creature
Duration: 1 minute
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless);Power Resistance: yes (harmless)
Power Points: psionic focus or 1

DESCRIPTION

You grant one member of your collective a +1 natural armor bonus for 1 minute.
